affected_subject.reason: Comparison functions (eq, lt) of the packedFloat library are identified as the affected component.

trigger_or_action.reason: Calling comparison functions on mathematically equal but differently represented (unnormalized) packedFloat inputs triggers the issue.

direct_effect.reason: Comparison returns mathematically wrong result (lt returns true for 1000 < 10), causing wrongful liquidation.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual relation: comparison should reflect mathematical value (1000 > 10, no liquidation) but actual returns true, violating mathematical expectation.

summary: Report identifies comparison functions, unnormalized input trigger, wrong comparison result causing wrongful liquidation, and the expected-vs-actual mathematical relation, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
